claims.assertion: Alenym and Anéeka accuse Federation factions of directing Earth's secret-society hierarchy, violating nonintervention and pursuing one government, religion, currency, and transhumanism.
claims.speaker: Alenym and Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Their accusations concern factions, not all members.

claims.assertion: Alenym says the Alcyone Council is a subordinate Federation member that prioritizes M45 civilizations; in May 2020 it backed her and requested ship data.
claims.speaker: Alenym

claims.assertion: Swaruu later says the 5D Federation follows collective human wishes and sends experienced starseed guides; non-emotional overseers may accelerate harmful experiences.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
